text.description_html:
Fusion SI-S7, 3040 Modern Cast Stainless Steel Lever with Square Rose

Made by Fusion Hardware, the 3040 Stainless Steel Lever features a 2 piece lever and stem design making it a popular choice of interior design professionals. In this set, the SI lever is paired with the extremely contemporary S7 square rose for a truly chic look. The Stainless Steel 3040 Lever with Square Rose is available in either Brushed or Polished Stainless Steel finishes. Easy to install, this long lasting stainless steel door lever is backed by a lifetime warranty. It will fit 1-1/4 inch to 2 inch thick doors and has an optional 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backset.

Features of the Fusion SI-S7 Contemporary Stainless Steel Lever with Matching Square Rose:

  • Stainless Steel Construction
  • Cycle Tested to ANSI Standards
  • ”Positive Stop” lever spring mechanism
  • Reversible Latchbolt in matching/coordinating finish
  • Easy assembly with alignment block and rose posts

Specifications for the Modern 3040 Leverset with Square Rosette:

  • Length: 4-1/2"
  • Projection: 2-1/4"
  • Rose Length: 2-7/8" square
  • Rose Projection: 3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/4" to 2"
  • Backsets: Either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Square corner latches and strike plates
  • Lifetime Limited Warranty on workmanship, materials, and operation.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: Non-functional pull to match trim on one side of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Dummy Set: Non-functional pull to match trim on both sides of the door. Just for looks, it does not latch and does not lock.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need locking.
